response.response: Witness continuity is a world-space predicate. It never reads camera quaternion, screen visibility, reticle alignment, player look direction, a gaze dwell, music time, or optional foliage density. An offered intermediate reference records a grounded world position and identity. F offers it while the player occupies its inner cylinder. The player remains its witness while grounded in the same world inside the release cylinder and while the relevant worker-to-reference segment is clear against signed, tier-stable solid terrain/trunk geometry. The longer route uses the established fixed survey reference; the shorter route needs the offered occupied intermediate reference through its occluded bend. A newly drawn untested endpoint cannot silently become a replacement fixed reference and erase that distinction. W-7744's reciprocal reference is the corresponding actor-owned state: a validated safe pose, an explicitly established reference, and an unobstructed relation during the player's actual passage. Actor/instrument orientation presents that relation but render-camera orientation never decides it. Looking away changes nothing. Leaving the witness cylinder safely holds the worker at his last supported sample and preserves tested proof; returning to the inner cylinder resumes when the same offered reference and unwalked span are valid. Missing reference and invalid footing have different repair paths. All geometry values remain candidate values until actual route feasibility is demonstrated; signing the narrative candidate does not certify an unmeasured arena.
